It’s not like I’m trying to be a jerk, it’s just… the thought is already there and my mouth goes before I’ve checked myself. Then afterward I’m like, why didn’t I just wait two seconds?\n\nDoctor: Do you spend a lot of time worrying about different parts of your life, even when there isn’t a clear reason to?\n\nPatient: I don’t know if I’d call it worrying, exactly.
